quest.title: Blocked?
quest.description: As Quinn was transporting fruit back to Mondstadt, his path was blocked near the Thousand Winds Temple, and he was ambushed by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Quinn.

talks.objective: Go see what's going on up ahead
Defeat all opponents and destroy the roadblocks

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: My plan was to pick some fruit here then sell it back in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I hadn't counted on being held up by a roadblock... and then set upon by that group.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Okay, I'm going back to Mondstadt. Do stop by the shop if you're ever in town!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Take these as a token of my gratitude. See how fresh they are? That's why Beatrice is always trying to buy them from me.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Thanks for getting rid of them, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Thank goodness you came. *sigh* But I'm stuck here while this roadblock continues.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: If this keeps up much longer, all this fruit is going to go bad... after I spent so long gathering it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Can you get rid of the roadblock for me?

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Wonderful. I can't thank you enough!

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Oh... Really? I figured if you help someone out, you see it through all the way... Anyway, you're the only hope I've got.
